mapper.select: SELECT merchant_category_id, category_code, category_name, display_order FROM merchant_categories WHERE is_map_visible = TRUE ORDER BY display_order ASC
SELECT kakao_category_group_code FROM kakao_category_maps WHERE merchant_category_id = #{merchantCategoryId} AND enabled = TRUE AND kakao_category_group_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY priority ASC
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM merchant_categories WHERE merchant_category_id = #{merchantCategoryId} AND is_map_visible = TRUE )

SELECT mapping.merchant_category_id, category.category_code, mapping.kakao_category_group_code, mapping.kakao_category_name_pattern, mapping.match_method, mapping.confidence_score, mapping.benefit_match_policy, mapping.priority FROM kakao_category_maps mapping INNER JOIN kakao_category_group_registry registry ON registry.kakao_category_group_code = mapping.kakao_category_group_code AND registry.benefit_mapping_supported = TRUE INNER JOIN merchant_categories category ON category.merchant_category_id = mapping.merchant_category_id WHERE mapping.kakao_category_group_code = #{kakaoCategoryGroupCode} AND mapping.enabled = TRUE ORDER BY mapping.priority ASC, mapping.kakao_category_map_id ASC
